scenes.heading: Choosing the right platform for your store

sents.d: Choosing the right platform for your store
The best platform depends on your product and technical comfort, not hype.

Common options include hosted platforms that handle technical setup for a monthly fee, self-hosted open-source platforms that offer more control but require more technical maintenance, and established marketplaces with built-in traffic but less brand control.

For most beginners, a hosted platform trades some flexibility for a much faster, simpler setup — a reasonable trade-off when validating a new product idea rather than committing to heavy technical infrastructure upfront.

Marketplaces can be a useful way to test demand quickly since they come with existing traffic, but typically charge higher fees and limit your ability to build a direct, ownable relationship with customers compared to your own store.

take: Start on a hosted platform; use marketplaces to test demand.
